title: Big Buck Bunny
description: A giant rabbit takes comic revenge on three bullying rodents.
fullDescription: A gentle giant rabbit wakes to a sunny morning in the forest until three mischievous rodents start tormenting the butterflies he loves.

title: Sintel
description: A lonely young woman searches the world for her lost dragon.
fullDescription: Sintel travels through snowy mountains and deserts to find the baby dragon she once befriended. Her journey is full of danger, and the truth she finds at the end is unforgettable. An open animated fantasy short from the Blender Foundation.

title: Tears of Steel
description: Warriors and scientists try to save the world from killer robots.
fullDescription: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists and soldiers attempt to stop a robot invasion by reliving a painful moment from the past. Live action mixed with visual effects, from the Blender Foundation.

title: Elephants Dream
description: Two strangers explore a surreal, machine-like world.
fullDescription: Emo and Proog wander through a strange, giant mechanical world. One wants to understand it, the other is not sure it is real. The first open movie made with Blender.

title: Cosmos Laundromat
description: A man who has given up on life meets a salesman with many offers.
fullDescription: On a lonely island, Franck meets a strange salesman who offers him a chance to live other lives. A thoughtful animated short from the Blender Institute.

title: Spring
description: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits to bring back the seasons.
fullDescription: In a mountain valley, a young shepherd girl and her dog must face the spirits of the land. A beautiful animated short from Blender Studio.

title: Crimson Protocol
description: A rogue agent has 48 hours to stop a global blackout.
fullDescription: When a hidden network starts shutting down power grids across the world, one former agent must break into the most secure vault on Earth. Every hour brings a new betrayal.

title: Last Lap to Maseru
description: A racing driver crosses the mountains in one night to save her team.
fullDescription: Rain, rough roads and a rival who plays dirty. A young racing driver has until sunrise to reach the finish line in Maseru and win back her family's garage.

title: Mix-Up at the Market
description: Two market traders swap orders and cause a day of chaos.
fullDescription: When two rival market traders accidentally swap their deliveries, a simple Saturday turns into a town-wide comedy of errors with runaway chickens and one very confused mayor.

title: Rivers Remember
description: Three generations of one family return to the village they left.
fullDescription: When their grandmother falls ill, a family returns to the village by the river. Old secrets, forgotten songs and a land worth fighting for bring them together.

title: The Hollow Hour
description: Every night at 3 a.m. the old school bell starts ringing.
fullDescription: A new night guard at an abandoned school hears the bell ring at exactly 3 a.m. Each night it is louder, and each night something answers.

title: Skyward Kingdom
description: A curious cloud-keeper discovers a kingdom above the storm.
